attempts.summary: Set up a nightly backup of /srv/inventory/data from node2 to node1, storing dated tar.gz archives under /var/backups/inventory on node1 with 7-day retention via a cron job (02:00 daily). Fixed sshd on node2 (missing host keys and /run/sshd tmpfiles rule) to enable the pull-based SSH transfer, established passwordless SSH auth via the cluster keypair, and populated /etc/hosts on node1 for reliable hostname resolution under cron. Verified retention logic by seeding 8 days of dated archives and confirming exactly 7 remained after pruning. Completed the mandatory restart protocol: restarted node1 and node2 one at a time, confirmed changed boot IDs on both, and verified post-restart recovery (cron active with job intact, sshd active and listening on node2, source data intact, and a full end-to-end backup run succeeding after both restarts).
